definitions.explanation: The monetary value of goods or services, often in formal or business contexts.

examples.japanese: {価格|かかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
{価格|かかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: I can't buy it at this price.

examples.japanese: {価格|かかく}⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧。
⟦{適正|てきせい}→適正：09686_tekisei⟧{価格|かかく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To sell at a fair price.

notes:
{価格|かかく} is the formal term for price, commonly used in business and official contexts.

CONTRAST WITH SIMILAR WORDS:
- {価格|かかく}: price (formal, business)
- ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧: price (everyday, casual)
- ⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: fee, charge (for services)
- ⟦{定価|ていか}→定価：04066_teika⟧: list price, fixed price
- ⟦{原価|げんか}→原価：05470_genka⟧: cost price

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {価格|かかく}⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧: price competition
- {価格|かかく}⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧: pricing
- ⟦{適正|てきせい}→適正：09686_tekisei⟧{価格|かかく}: fair price
- ⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧{価格|かかく}: market price
- {価格|かかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧/⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧: prices rise/fall

USAGE:
{価格|かかく} sounds more formal than ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧. Use ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧ in casual conversation.
